executive_summary.text: FAIRVIEW (075288): Operational / Managerial Control from 2008-05-02 to present; staffing during this period averaged 4.29 total nurse HPRD over 35 quarters.
In cost year 2025, homes linked to this company reported $24,167 in management fees on DSS cost reports.
